Applications received late are not accepted.

content_sections.heading: About FREMAA
content_sections.text: FREMAA, with its office on the 4th floor of the Assam Water Centre, NH 27, Basistha Chariali, Guwahati - 781029, is an autonomous society of the Government of Assam and the implementing agency for the externally aided projects of the Water Resources Department, Assam. Both posts are under the Assam Integrated River Basin Management Program (AIRBMP), a multi-phase programme (2023-2033) aided by the World Bank (IBRD) to reduce people's vulnerability to climate-related disasters and improve integrated water resources management in Assam. FREMAA steers the programme as the Project Management Unit (PMU), while the Assam Water Resources Department (WRD) and the Assam State Disaster Management Authority (ASDMA) are the Project Implementation Units (PIUs). Phase 1 runs from 2023 to 2027. The notice gives the total outlay as US$ 625 million, of which USD 500 million is World Bank assistance and USD 125 million is counterpart funding from the State Government.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go only by email, and they must reach the email addresses by the end of day on 3 December 2026. Incomplete applications are not accepted. Download the prescribed application format from FREMAA's website, www.fremaa.assam.gov.in . Fill in the application in the English language and address it to the CEO, FREMAA. Prepare a signed cover letter. Scan the supporting documents of age, qualification and experience. Email the cover letter, the application and the scanned documents to both [email protected] and [email protected] . Use the subject line "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ......", completed with the post you are applying for (Assistant Finance Officer or Accounts Assistant).

content_sections.heading: FREMAA Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Officer assists and supports the CEO and the finance team of the PMU in the financial management of the project, with tasks including (but not limited to): Helping the project keep to the annual work plan and budget (AWPB) and the AWPBs of the PIUs and sub-projects, including measuring sub-project indicators. Helping develop a quality and realistic AWPB for later years, and monitoring progress against the AWPB. Checking bills/invoices for consultancies, civil works, goods and other claims under the projects and submitting them for approval. Ensuring timely deposit of Salary, Allowances, GPF, Professional Tax, other project management expenditures and other dues in Treasury/Banks. Maintaining the Book of A/Cs, including electronic maintenance of the Book of Accounts. Producing project reporting documents and Quarterly and Annual Reports; monitoring sub-project outputs and outcomes against the Results Framework indicators. Undertaking field visits and random checks of the books of accounts kept by the PIUs. Assisting with procurement, records and maintenance of equipment and tools where needed. Preparing and submitting reimbursement claims/Withdrawal Applications, Annual Financial Statements, Income and Expenditure Statements and Audit Reports. Supporting internal and statutory audits and ensuring timely compliance with audit observations. Preparing financial reports for Central and State Government review meetings, organising project review meetings with PIUs/MDB, recording minutes and following up on the action taken report. Handling official communications and coordination with stakeholder departments, PIUs, agencies and the MDBs, and any other work assigned by the Authority. The Officer must manage day-to-day work with high dedication, integrity and ethical behaviour, should not have any conflict of interest, and must keep information confidential as required under the rules and acts in force and the policies of the MDBs. Assist the officers of the Finance Wing of FREMAA in all accounting and financial matters. Keep records of all files/transactions/Book of Accounts and maintain them in Tally. Handle statutory compliances, Audit and the submission of claims to ADB/WB, etc. For both posts, FREMAA provides office space with furniture and utilities, access to all reports, studies, data, photographs and maps relating to the works, access to all sites for surveys and investigations, and counterpart staff to work with.

Shortlisted candidates must bring all original certificates/documents, along with a set of self-attested copies of certificates supporting age, address, qualification and marks obtained, experience, trainings received and the last drawn salary slip. The originals are returned after they are checked against the self-attested copies. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in FREMAA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Assistant Finance Officer and one Accounts Assistant, both on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for FREMAA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the FREMAA email addresses by the end of day on 3 December 2026; late or incomplete applications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the FREMAA Assistant Finance Officer post?
faq.answer: A full-time first-class Master's in Commerce with specialization in Accountancy or Finance, or intermediate level of CA/ICWA or equivalent, with at least 5 years of experience in financial accounting and management and mandatory proficiency in Tally ERP 9.0, MS Word, Excel and Power-point.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the FREMAA Accounts Assistant post?
faq.answer: A Graduate in Commerce/Finance from a recognised university with minimum 55% marks or equivalent CGPA in aggregate, knowledge of Tally ERP 9.0, and 5 years of experience in a similar work profile.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for FREMAA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For Assistant Finance Officer the maximum age limit is 45 years; for Accounts Assistant it is not below 24 years and not above 45 years, both as on 01/01/2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the FREMAA posts?
faq.answer: Assistant Finance Officer gets Rs 40,000/ to Rs 50,000/- per month and Accounts Assistant Rs 35,000 per month, inclusive of local taxes, with TA/DA and other allowances as per FREMAA norms.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for FREMAA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email a signed cover letter, the application in the prescribed format from www.fremaa.assam.gov.in and scanned documents of age, qualification and experience to [email protected] and [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What should be the email subject line for the FREMAA application?
faq.answer: The subject line should be "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ......", completed with the post being applied for.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for FREMAA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through an interview, and only shortlisted candidates will be intimated and called for it.

faq.question: Q10. Are the FREMAA posts permanent?
faq.answer: No, both posts are contractual for eleven months initially; the Assistant Finance Officer contract is renewed based on performance as per FREMAA's HR policy, and the Accounts Assistant contract is extendable based on satisfactory performance.
